notes: 2026-11-01: Code or ANSI output to PNG, SVG or WebP with window chrome; the SVG output suits GSAP layers.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it worth cataloguing.
summary: CLI that renders source code or terminal output to PNG, SVG and WebP, with configurable themes and framing. It is useful for polished, repeatable code and terminal stills without a manual screenshot.
use_when: Create styled code or terminal-output stills from scripts
Export SVG when downstream vector composition is useful
avoid_when: Use browser capture for dynamic UI states or web typography
Use a text rasterizer for precise typesetting control

assessment.rationale: Official project sources identify 0.2.2 as the latest available version/release (2025-04-01); maintenance assessed from release evidence. Documentation assessment only; no local installation or fixture evidence.
